description: Enable agent to coordinate multiple tools/APIs in service of complex goals. Current tools include: code generation, GitHub operations, file system, npm/build tools, API calls. Must demonstrate intelligent tool selection, proper sequencing, error handling across tools, and fallback strategies. Multi-tool orchestration scores higher than single-tool use.

status.comment: Cancelled 24 July 2026 as hackathon scoring noise. Selecting and sequencing several tools with error handling is normal agent execution, already exercised by the loop; it is not a separate Aimparency capability to build. Add scoped integration aims only for missing tools or concrete cross-tool failures.

reflection: The description explicitly justified this because multi-tool orchestration “scores higher than single-tool use.” With that external scoring premise stale, no distinct deliverable remains.
